description: This file defines a base class for all Result classes in a DBIx::Class schema, including component loading, a method to return object data as a hashref, and a custom has_many relationship handler.

classes.name: Coocook::Schema::Result
classes.description: A base class for all Result classes in the Coocook schema, providing common functionality and component loading.

methods.name: as_hashref
methods.description: Returns a hashref containing all column values of the object, with optional additional key/value pairs.

methods.name: has_many
methods.description: Overrides the default has_many relationship method to set cascade_copy to false by default and handle argument validation.
